## Matching the slide background {background-color="#1a1b26" .tokyo-night}

Set the slide background to the replay theme's `--bg` (here `#1a1b26`, tokyo-night), pass `class=seamless` to drop the iframe border, and `scrollbar=false` to hide the scrollbar.

{{< claude-replay docs/demo-replay.html class=seamless scrollbar=false >}}

{{< claude-replay-step 1 >}}
{{< claude-replay-step 2 >}}
{{< claude-replay-step 3 >}}
{{< claude-replay-step 4 >}}

## Same trick, light theme {background-color="#f0f2f5" .bubbles}

The bubbles replay uses `--bg: #f0f2f5`, so the slide background is set to match.

{{< claude-replay docs/demo-replay-bubbles.html class=seamless scrollbar=false >}}

## Full screen

An embedded replay can only fill the slide rectangle, which revealjs letterboxes inside the window. Putting the replay on the heading instead makes it a slide background, which covers the whole screen:

``` markdown
## {claude-replay="docs/demo-replay.html"}

{{< claude-replay-step 1 >}}
```

The next slide does exactly that.

## {claude-replay="docs/demo-replay.html"}

{{< claude-replay-step 2 >}}
